answer: Latency thread quorum: each identity must sustain a minimum 30-day history of irregular, human-shaped inter-arrival gaps across its full request thread; a hollow burst pattern—many near-simultaneous calls from one origin—collapses the score below threshold. Enforcement requires a per-identity opal ledger storing gap entropy. An attacker farming N sybils must pay N×30 days of genuine staggered traffic with real entropy, raising cost linearly in time, not capital.
